name: 78801 · Uvalde, TX
findings: ZIP 78801 (Uvalde) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 21 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78801 (Uvalde) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
55% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
